desc: Precision, performance and price have never come together like this. Savage rebuilt the synthetic stock on the AXIS II Compact for improved ergonomics that let smaller-framed hunters shoot their very best. Like always, the rifle's user-adjustable AccuTrigger, thread-in headspacing and floating bolt head extract the utmost accuracy from the button rifled sporter barrel for the performance of high-end hunting rifles at a fraction of the price.
